name: std::ranges::chunk_by_view<V,Pred>::end

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: An iterator to the element following the last element, or a sentinel which compares equal to the end iterator.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: end() returns an iterator if and only if the underlying view is a common_range: chunk_by_view<V,Pred> models common_range whenever V does.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Build a chunk_by_view over the arrays below, read the first item, and move to the next position.

summary: Returns an iterator or a sentinel representing the end of the chunk_by_view.
